issue.title: feat(runtime): implement regression harness for pipeline behavior
issue.body:
## Problem
Build a harness that runs a set of golden tasks against the pipeline and compares outputs to baseline, failing on regression.

## Context
Located in runtime/eval_suite.py; invokes pipeline as a library; no external services.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Harness executes all golden tasks and produces a pass/fail report
- [ ] Any deviation beyond allowed tolerance marks the run as failed
- [ ] Failed runs produce a diff artifact for debugging
